script.title: Detached HEAD: kaam gaya kya?

dialogue.speaker: taplu
dialogue.text: Maine purana commit checkout kiya aur ab Git bol raha hai detached HEAD. Mera kaam gaya kya?

chat.display: git bol raha detached HEAD 😭 mera kaam gaya kya??

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: Kuch nahi gaya. HEAD abhi kisi branch par nahi, seedha ek commit par khada hai.

chat.display: kuch nahi gaya 😌 HEAD ek commit pe khada hai, kisi branch pe nahi

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Main toh wahin hoon jahan tha. Tumne mujhe chhua hi nahi.

chat.display: main toh wahin hoon bro, mujhe chhua hi nahi 🤷

dialogue.speaker: taplu
dialogue.text: Par maine yahan do naye commits bhi kar diye. Agar ab main branch pe switch karun, toh unka kya hoga?

chat.display: par maine yahan 2 commits bhi kar diye… ab main pe gaya toh unka kya hoga? 🤔

pause.prompt: You made 2 commits on a detached HEAD and switch back to main. What happens to those commits?
choices: No branch points to them, so they are easy to lose

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: Woh kisi branch par nahi hain, toh dheere dheere kho sakte hain. Abhi ek branch bana lo, unka ghar ban jaayega.

chat.display: unka koi ghar nahi 👻 abhi branch bana lo

dialogue.speaker: john
dialogue.text: Phir mujhme merge kar dena, sab safe rahega.

script.takeaway: A detached HEAD points at a commit, not a branch; create a branch before switching away so new commits are kept.

questions.prompt: Why create a branch before switching away from a detached HEAD?
choices: So a branch points to your new commits and they are kept
questions.explanation: Commits that no branch points to can be lost; a branch keeps them reachable.
